categories.optional_improvement: compare defensible weighting schemes and report weight sensitivity
categories.why: The problem compares alternatives across directional indicators and requires an auditable ranking.
main_assumptions: indicator direction and scale are defined
weights represent a declared source of preference or information
validation_plan: normalize benefit and cost indicators explicitly
compare rankings with the simple baseline
categories.complexity_upgrade_condition: Upgrade only when the baseline cannot represent a documented dependency or uncertainty in the indicators.

categories.optional_improvement: use a tree ensemble only when sample size and nonlinear validation justify it
categories.why: Prediction requires out-of-sample evidence and should begin with an interpretable benchmark.
main_assumptions: training and evaluation data represent the target setting
features are available at prediction time
failure_risks: small data with an over-parameterized model
reporting in-sample fit as prediction quality
validation_plan: use a time-respecting or held-out split
inspect error distribution and boundary cases
categories.complexity_upgrade_condition: Upgrade only when repeated out-of-sample evaluation identifies a material baseline defect that the added model fixes.

categories.recommended_primary_model: mixed integer programming when discrete decisions require it
categories.optional_improvement: use a documented heuristic only after an exact formulation exceeds the available time or scale
categories.why: The problem chooses decisions under explicit objectives and constraints.
main_assumptions: objective and constraints encode the actual decision
units and feasibility bounds are consistent
failure_risks: using a metaheuristic when an exact solver is sufficient
validation_plan: compare with a simple feasible baseline
report bound or optimality gap when available
categories.complexity_upgrade_condition: Upgrade from an exact baseline only when nonlinearity, discreteness, scale, or multiple objectives create a measured limitation.

categories.recommended_baseline: logistic regression for labels or K-Means for unlabeled groups
categories.recommended_primary_model: tree-based classifier or hierarchical clustering after diagnostics
categories.optional_improvement: select density clustering only when irregular cluster shape and noise are demonstrated
categories.why: The task assigns observations to known labels or discovers defensible groups.
main_assumptions: features have comparable meaning after preprocessing
labels or distance choices match the question
validation_plan: use held-out classification metrics or cluster stability
inspect confusion or membership boundary cases
categories.complexity_upgrade_condition: Upgrade only when baseline errors or unstable clusters identify a specific structural defect.

categories.recommended_baseline: shortest path or minimum spanning tree under the declared objective
categories.recommended_primary_model: network optimization matching the decision constraints
categories.optional_improvement: add community or centrality analysis only when it answers a separate declared question
categories.why: Entities and relationships form a network whose topology affects the answer.
main_assumptions: nodes and edges have explicit meaning
edge direction and weight units are correct
validation_plan: compare with a hand-checkable small graph
categories.complexity_upgrade_condition: Upgrade only when the simple graph objective omits a documented capacity, direction, or multi-commodity constraint.

categories.optional_improvement: use ARIMA or a state space model after trend seasonality and residual diagnostics
categories.why: Observation order and temporal dependence are load-bearing.
main_assumptions: timestamps and sampling intervals are reliable
future information is excluded from fitting
validation_plan: inspect residual autocorrelation and change points
categories.complexity_upgrade_condition: Upgrade only when rolling evaluation shows stable gains over the naive and smoothing baselines.

categories.optional_improvement: use a PDE only when spatial or continuous-state variation is essential
categories.why: The problem describes state change through time or space using conservation or transition laws.
main_assumptions: state variables and conservation relations are defined
parameter units are dimensionally consistent
categories.complexity_upgrade_condition: Upgrade only when the simpler dynamics cannot reproduce a decision-relevant observed mechanism.

categories.recommended_primary_model: discrete event simulation when queues and events drive outcomes
categories.optional_improvement: use agent-based simulation only when heterogeneous local behavior is load-bearing
categories.why: Analytic evaluation is unavailable or uncertainty and event interactions determine outcomes.
main_assumptions: input distributions or transition rules have declared sources
simulation horizon and warmup are adequate
failure_risks: simulation output treated as real observation
validation_plan: compare with an analytic or hand-checkable baseline
categories.complexity_upgrade_condition: Upgrade only when the simple simulation omits a measured interaction that changes the decision.

categories.recommended_baseline: nearest feasible facility or shortest feasible route
categories.recommended_primary_model: facility-location or routing optimization with explicit constraints
categories.optional_improvement: add a heuristic only when exact routing exceeds the measured contest budget
categories.why: Coordinates distance coverage or route order directly affects the decision.
main_assumptions: coordinate system and distance metric are declared
capacity and accessibility constraints are complete
failure_risks: Euclidean distance used for inaccessible routes
categories.complexity_upgrade_condition: Upgrade only when the baseline violates a documented spatial or routing constraint.

categories.optional_improvement: add dimensionality reduction only when redundancy and retained information are quantified
categories.why: Input quality and representation must be defensible before modeling.
main_assumptions: missingness and outlier definitions are explicit
transformations use no future or target leakage
validation_plan: test conclusions under plausible preprocessing choices
categories.complexity_upgrade_condition: Upgrade only when a measured data defect remains after the deterministic baseline.
